reviews.title: Great for a mining rig
reviews.comment: This cpu couldn’t handle too much, but it is perfect for a mining rig and mining software. Handles multiple chrome tabs and still pretty fast. Great value.
reviews.author: JJ

reviews.title: One of the cheapest 10th gen cpus you can buy
reviews.comment: If you just need a 10th gen cpu to get a computer running, this will fit the bill. It doesn't take much to cool it and it doesn't use much power. It's not meant to run a lot of heavily threaded applications, but at 2 cores, it can run single threaded applications just fine.
reviews.author: Monte Jeu
